english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the creator of a book or other work.
Use 作者 when identifying the author or creator of a particular book, article, song, or other work.

examples.english: Who is the author of this book?
examples.traditional: 呢本書嘅作者係邊個呀？
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3

examples.english: The writer of this book is from Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 呢本書嘅作者係一位香港人。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 hai6 jat1 wai2 hoeng1 gong2 jan4
